title: BaseEvent
description: Common fields present on every AECP event. All event schemas extend this via allOf.

event_id.description: Unique identifier (UUID v4) for this event instance. Never reused.

event_type.description: Discriminator field — identifies the event category for routing and filtering.

schema_version.description: Schema version for forward-compatibility. Consumers should handle unknown minor versions gracefully.

timestamp.description: UTC creation time of this event in ISO 8601 format (e.g. 2026-03-29T14:00:00.000Z).

correlation_id.description: Trace correlation ID propagated across the full execution chain. Used for end-to-end observability.
